import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out missing values and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
sns.histplot(data=age_data, bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax2, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# Plot 3: Dog Gender Distribution by District (Top 6 Districts)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
top_districts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().head(6).index
district_gender = df[df['KreisLang'].isin(top_districts)].groupby(['KreisLang', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
district_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['coral', 'steelblue'], edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('District')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Top 6 Districts')
ax3.legend(title='Dog Gender')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 4: Registration Trends Over Years
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_registrations = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum()
ax4.plot(yearly_registrations.index, yearly_registrations.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkgreen', markerfacecolor='lightgreen', markeredgecolor='darkgreen')
ax4.fill_between(yearly_registrations.index, yearly_registrations.values, alpha=0.3, color='green')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Dog Registrations')
ax4.set_title('Dog Registration Trends Over Years')
ax4.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
